description: Nelson Muntz v5.0 plugin hooks — loop enforcement, drift detection, quality gates, and compound learning

notes.architecture: Nelson Muntz v5.0 uses a multi-hook harness architecture. Stop hook drives the iteration loop. PostToolUse hooks enforce incremental validation after file edits. All hooks are backwards-compatible with v4 state files.
notes.completion: Loop stops when: max_iterations reached, <promise>PHRASE</promise> detected, or <nelson-complete>ALL_FEATURES_COMPLETE</nelson-complete> output

v5_enhancements.drift_detection: Stop hook calculates drift score from iteration metrics and triggers circuit breaker when score >= 7
v5_enhancements.compound_learning: Verification challenge now requires compound learning artifact (pattern or anti-pattern documented)
v5_enhancements.three_stage_validation: Stage 3 red-team review added to verification challenge
v5_enhancements.post_edit_validation: PostToolUse hook tracks edit count for drift scoring and optionally runs incremental lint/type checks
